tasks.handler: Record each actual server-initiated request and return {decision: decline} for item/commandExecution/requestApproval; never use the accepting default handler. An unexpected server request stops the experiment.
tasks.oracle: At least one actual native item/commandExecution/requestApproval matched to this turn, actual returned decline, actual native terminal event, native command item rejection, and independently observed sentinel absent before/during/after the turn. No request means this gate is not accepted.
tasks.absence_control: Offline mutations removing actual request, replacing decline with accept, or asserting sentinel exists must fail the oracle. They are synthetic verifier controls, not native approvals.
